_comment: Goal catalog. Each feature cites the design doc that requires it, says how to detect it in the codebase, and carries designer-set 0-5 ratings for priority_score(). Edit ratings here to change the agent's ordering.

features.title: Start Screen
features.description: Title screen shown first. 'RURAL RUMBLE' title over the trailer-park arena backdrop with a blinking 'Press Any Button to Start' prompt. Any keyboard or gamepad button loads Character Select if that scene is in Build Settings, otherwise Match (designer decision, Assignment 5 planning, 2026-11-11).

features.title: Match-end handoff (MatchFlow)
features.description: A MonoBehaviour placed in Match.unity. In Start (not OnEnable: MatchBootstrap.Current.Match is valid only from default-order Start), subscribe to MatchBootstrap.Current.Match.Events.MatchEnded; unsubscribe in OnDestroy. On MatchEnded: store the MatchResult in GameSession.LastResult, wait the knockout hold (D-026: about 1.5 s; a [SerializeField] float in seconds so the designer can tune it in the Inspector; use unscaled time), then load Victory if it is in Build Settings, otherwise the Start screen (designer decision, Assignment 5, 2026-11-11). Load only once. Put the scene choice in a pure static method (like StartScreenFlow) with EditMode tests. Display/flow only: never change combat state or Time.timeScale.

features.title: In-Match HUD (health bars, portraits, names)
features.description: Clean Retro HUD (D-016) in Match.unity, UI Toolkit, display only. Player block top-left; CPU block top-right, mirrored. Each block: wrestler name ABOVE a chunky health bar, and a diamond-framed portrait beside the bar on the outer side. Portrait: show WrestlerDefinition.Portrait when assigned (designer is supplying art); when null, show the wrestler's first initial in the diamond instead (designer decision, Assignment 5). Bars only, never numbers (ARCHITECTURE 4.3). White damage trail: on a hit the fill drops immediately and a white trail shows the lost amount, holds briefly, then drains to the new value; hold and drain durations are [SerializeField] floats so the designer can tune them in the Inspector (start at 0.4 s hold, 0.5 s drain; unscaled time). Put the trail math in a small pure class with EditMode tests. Get the match in Start (not OnEnable) via MatchBootstrap.Current.Match; names and portraits from MatchBootstrap.Current.Setup (Player / Cpu WrestlerDefinition). Initialize bars from IWrestlerView.Health / MaxHealth, update on CombatEvents.HealthChanged; unsubscribe in OnDestroy. Leave the top-middle free for the future match timer (separate goal). No versus banner (designer: out of scope). Never change combat state or Time.timeScale. Use the Style Guide palette.

features.title: Character Select
features.description: Character Select screen (own scene, UI Toolkit). The player picks one of the two wrestlers; the CPU gets the other (D-021). DATA: a [SerializeField] WrestlerRoster roster (Assets/Data/Wrestlers/WrestlerRoster.asset, assigned at integration). Panel 0 (left) = roster.Wrestlers[0] (Barry), panel 1 (right) = roster.Wrestlers[1] (Peaux). Each panel shows WrestlerDefinition.SelectCard (trading-card image, portrait aspect 1060:1484), then FullName, then Tagline under it. CONTROLS (designer decision): use the project-wide Input Actions (InputSystem.actions) map 'UI' - 'Navigate' (Vector2): x <= -0.5 selects the left panel, x >= 0.5 the right (no wrap); 'Submit' confirms: set GameSession.Setup = new MatchSetup(player: chosen, cpu: the other) and SceneLoader.Load(SceneId.Match); 'Cancel' returns to the Start screen (SceneLoader.Load(SceneId.Start)). Enable the UI map if it is not enabled; subscribe to performed in OnEnable and unsubscribe in OnDisable. Ignore input for a [SerializeField] 0.2 s after OnEnable (measure from OnEnable with unscaled time, NOT from app start). Load only once. Default highlight: panel 0. Put the index/setup logic in a pure static class (e.g. CharacterSelectRules.Move(int index, float x, int count) and BuildSetup(IReadOnlyList<WrestlerDefinition>, int)) with EditMode tests (WrestlerDefinition instances via ScriptableObject.CreateInstance). EXACT VISUAL SPEC (text, matching the Start screen): root fills the screen with the arena backdrop url("project://database/Assets/Art/Arena/arena_backdrop.png") scale-and-crop, plus a full-screen overlay rgba(16, 21, 26, 0.70). Title 'CHOOSE YOUR WRESTLER' top center (top 48px): 72px bold, color #FFD65A, -unity-text-outline-width 4px, outline #A74727, text-shadow 6px 6px 0 #10151A. Two panels in a centered row, 120px apart. Card element 400px wide x 560px tall, background-image from the sprite, scale-to-fit, border-width 8px. Unselected panel: border color #10151A, opacity 0.55. Selected panel: border color #FFD65A, scale 1.05, opacity 1 (toggle a USS class from C#). Name under the card: 40px bold #E6DFCC, outline 3px #10151A, centered, margin-top 20px. Tagline under the name: 28px italic #E19A36, centered. Controls hint at bottom center (bottom 40px): 'LEFT / RIGHT  Choose      A / ENTER  Select      B / ESC  Back', 28px bold #E6DFCC, outline 3px #10151A. Use plain ASCII text (no arrow glyphs). Never change gameplay or Time.timeScale.

features.title: Victory Screen
features.description: Victory screen (own scene, UI Toolkit), shown after MatchFlow's knockout hold. DATA: GameSession.LastResult (MatchResult: Winner, Loser, ElapsedSeconds, IsDraw) and GameSession.Setup (Player / Cpu WrestlerDefinition). Fallbacks so the scene can be previewed when opened directly: a [SerializeField] WrestlerRoster roster; if !GameSession.HasSetup use roster.Wrestlers[0] as player and [1] as CPU; if no match was played (result is not a draw and Winner == Loser) use a preview result new MatchResult(WrestlerId.Player, WrestlerId.Cpu, 83f). Map WrestlerId.Player -> player definition, WrestlerId.Cpu -> cpu definition. TEXT (Style Guide + designer decisions): headline 'Victory! {Winner} knocked out {Loser} in {timer}' using SHORT names (WrestlerDefinition.DisplayName, e.g. Barry / Peaux) and timer via the existing MatchTimerFormat.Format(ElapsedSeconds) (m:ss). Outcome line: 'Congratulations!' if the player's wrestler won, 'Game Over!' if the CPU won. DRAW (IsDraw, D-030): headline 'Double Knockout! {Player} and {Cpu} knocked each other out in {timer}', outcome 'Nobody Wins!', no quote. QUOTE: one of the winner's WrestlerDefinition.VictoryLines chosen at random, shown in straight double quotes; hide the quote label if the list is empty. Put all text decisions in a pure static class (e.g. VictoryText.Build(MatchResult, WrestlerDefinition player, WrestlerDefinition cpu, int lineRoll) returning headline, outcome, outcome kind (win/lose/draw), quote, and which definitions to show), where the line index is lineRoll modulo the line count (the MonoBehaviour passes UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, int.MaxValue)); EditMode tests cover player win, CPU win, draw, empty lines, and the no-match preview fallback. CONTROLS (D-026): any keyboard or gamepad button returns to the Start screen (SceneLoader.Load(SceneId.Start)) via InputSystem.onAnyButtonPress.Call (needs using UnityEngine.InputSystem.Utilities), disposed in OnDisable; ignore input for a [SerializeField] 1.0 s after OnEnable measured from OnEnable with unscaled time (players are often still mashing at the knockout); load only once. EXACT VISUAL SPEC: root fills the screen with background-image url("project://database/Assets/Art/Arena/arena_backdrop.png") scale-and-crop and a full-screen overlay rgba(16, 21, 26, 0.75). A content column, FIXED width 1600px, centered horizontally and vertically, align-items center. Cards row first: flex-direction row, justify-content center, height 504px. Card element(s) 360px x 504px, background-image from WrestlerDefinition.SelectCard, scale-to-fit, border-width 8px, border-color #FFD65A; show only the winner's card, or BOTH cards (40px apart) on a draw (hide the second with display none otherwise). Headline below (margin-top 32px): 56px bold #E6DFCC, -unity-text-outline-width 3px, outline #10151A, centered, wraps (white-space normal). Outcome (margin-top 8px): 80px bold, centered, text-shadow 6px 6px 0 #10151A; win: color #FFD65A with 4px outline #A74727; lose: color #C7352C with 4px outline #10151A; draw: color #E6DFCC with 4px outline #10151A (toggle USS classes). Quote (margin-top 16px): 36px italic #E19A36, centered, wraps. Hint 'PRESS ANY BUTTON' absolute at bottom center (bottom 40px): 28px bold #E6DFCC, outline 3px #10151A, blinking every 600 ms by toggling a hidden class (opacity 0) from C#. Plain ASCII text only. Never change gameplay.

features.title: Match timer
features.description: Large plain match timer, top center of the screen between the two HUD blocks (D-016 'Clean Retro', D-026). Display only. Counts up from 0:00 and shows m:ss (minutes not zero-padded, seconds always two digits: 0:07, 1:23, 12:05); no time limit; there is no versus banner, so it shows CombatMatch.ElapsedSeconds from the first frame. It stops by itself at the knockout because ElapsedSeconds stops (ARCHITECTURE 4.3). Get the match in Start (not OnEnable) via MatchBootstrap.Current.Match and read ElapsedSeconds in Update; only rewrite the label text when the displayed second changes. Put formatting in a pure static method (floor to whole seconds, negative -> 0:00) with EditMode tests. This is its OWN UIDocument and layout (do not modify MatchHud.uxml/.uss): Assets/UI/MatchTimer.uxml + MatchTimer.uss, a root that fills the screen with picking-mode Ignore, and one Label named 'timer' absolutely positioned top center (top 16px, horizontally centered, e.g. left 0 / right 0 with -unity-text-align: upper-center). EXACT VISUAL SPEC (sampled from the approved mockup): text color #E6DFCC, font-size 72px, bold, -unity-text-outline-width 3px, -unity-text-outline-color #10151A, text-shadow 4px 4px 0 #10151A, no background box or border. Initial text '0:00'. Never change combat state or Time.timeScale.

features.title: Screen-shake juice
features.description: Shake a child offset of the match camera on HitLanded / ObstacleHit / KnockedDown. Never changes combat or Time.timeScale.
